name: Armored ATARAX Ripper
prompt:

Preserve its own compact head, heavy shoulder silhouette and layered surface relief.

Add natural thicker overlapping carapace protection to its existing shoulders, torso, forearms and shins, with no change in body plan. Preserve silver-gray/black colors and readable dark recesses.

Background: actual transparent alpha, no scenery or floor shadow.
No grid, sheets, duplicate poses, text, labels, border, logo, crop, new limbs, machinery, guns, blood, injury or gore. Original project adaptation, not official model certification and not animation.
